stories.title: Oud-studente van Cornell bedreigd na aanklacht over groepsverkrachting op campus

en.title: Former Cornell student threatened after filing gang rape complaint against seven men on campus
en.summary: A former Cornell University student who accused seven men of gang rape is receiving threats to drop her civil lawsuit, according to her attorney. The lawyer representing the woman, identified as Jane Doe, stated that both his client and he have been threatened.

stories.title: VS trekken bommenwerpers met spoed terug van Britse basis die werd gebruikt voor Iran-oorlog

en.title: US withdraws bombers urgently from British base that was used for Iran war
en.summary: The United States is rapidly withdrawing bombers from a British military base that had been utilized in preparations related to Iran operations.

stories.title: Gegevens van bijna 9 miljoen Denen buitgemaakt bij hack bevolkingsregister

en.title: Data of nearly 9 million Danes stolen in population registry hack
en.summary: Denmark's population registry was breached, compromising personal data of approximately 8.8 million Danish citizens, including names, addresses, and national identification numbers. The source of the hack remains unclear.

stories.title: Spanje vervroegd naar de stembus: premier Sánchez hoopt dat kiezers rechts straffen voor woningcrisis

en.title: Spain holds early elections: Prime Minister Sánchez hopes voters will punish the right over housing crisis
en.summary: Spain is holding early parliamentary elections as Prime Minister Sánchez seeks voter support, with housing crisis issues becoming a central campaign focus.

stories.title: Deens bevolkingsregister gehackt. Namen, adressen en BSN’s van bijna alle Denen buitgemaakt

en.title: Danish population register hacked. Names, addresses and ID numbers of nearly all Danes stolen
en.summary: Hackers exploited legitimate access to a Danish company's database to steal personal data including names, addresses, and ID numbers of nearly all Danish citizens. The breach was discovered in late September.

stories.title: Vrouw die studenten Cornell beschuldigt van groepsverkrachting wordt bedreigd

en.title: Woman accusing Cornell students of gang rape receives threats
en.summary: A woman who filed a complaint alleging gang rape at Cornell University is being threatened, according to her lawyer. She claims the university failed to protect her adequately and that the suspects faced insufficient punishment.

stories.title: Spaanse premier Sánchez kondigt vervroegde verkiezingen aan

en.title: Spanish Premier Sánchez announces early elections
en.summary: Spain will hold parliamentary elections in late November following an announcement by Premier Sánchez. The early election comes after weeks of protests over the country's housing crisis.

stories.title: Gegevens van bijna negen miljoen Denen buitgemaakt bij hack bevolkingsregister

en.title: Data of nearly nine million Danes stolen in population register hack
en.summary: Hackers accessed personal data of approximately 8.8 million people in Denmark's population register, including names, addresses, and ID numbers. The breach affects a significant portion of the register's approximately eleven million total entries.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro wint eerste ronde verkiezingen in Brazilië, tweede ronde nodig

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of elections in Brazil, second round needed
en.summary: Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's presidential election against incumbent left-wing president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Since Bolsonaro failed to secure over 50 percent of votes, a runoff election is scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Radicaal-rechtse Flavio Bolsonaro wint eerste ronde, maar Lula blijft strijdbaar

en.title: Radical-right Flavio Bolsonaro wins first round, but Lula remains combative
en.summary: The son of former president Jair Bolsonaro received over 47 percent of votes in Brazil's first round of presidential voting, while incumbent president Lula da Silva garnered 45 percent. Lula indicated the race remains competitive despite trailing in the first round.

stories.title: Bolsonaro junior verrassend aan kop na eerste verkiezingsronde in Brazilië

en.title: Bolsonaro junior surprisingly in the lead after first round of elections in Brazil
en.summary: Right-wing radical Flávio Bolsonaro leads the first round of Brazil's presidential election with nearly 47 percent of votes compared to incumbent president Lula's 45 percent. A second round is required since neither candidate achieved an absolute majority, with Bolsonaro's lead surprising many pre-election polls.

stories.title: Bolsonaro deelt eerste tik uit bij verkiezingen Brazilië, ongemeen spannende tweede ronde tegen Lula da Silva

en.title: Bolsonaro deals first blow in Brazil elections, exceptionally tight second round against Lula da Silva
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro has taken a narrow lead in the first round of Brazil's presidential election against incumbent Lula da Silva, setting up a closely contested runoff between the two candidates.
